6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageAbel
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold
8	
9	/-!
10	# DAT-B B-4 discharged at the admissible parameter: `ChartLocusAffineLocal` is UNCONDITIONAL
11	
12	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean` names the affine-local openness residue
13	`ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam` — "the *only* remaining input to CHART-U(b) at a general
14	test" (`Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean:127`) — and its only producers so far are **conditional**:
15	`chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` (`Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean:182`) asks for a
16	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` presentation per affine piece, and `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre`
17	(`Pic0ChartLocusPlusFibre.lean:128`) asks for a plus-fibre datum.  The obligation was priced by
18	two roadmap rows and survived into the `chartLocusOpens` `haff` argument as an unexhibited cost.
19	
20	**It is free at the admissible parameter, for degree-zero classes, and this file says so as a
21	theorem.**  `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`
22	(`Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold.lean:381`) proves that at the parameter
23	`m := admissibleCoverageParameter hπ g`, `Z := (…).choose`, the chart locus of **every**
24	`pic⁰` class over **every** test is all of `Set.univ` — a set that is open by
25	`isOpen_univ`.  `ChartLocusAffineLocal` asks for openness of the locus of the class *restricted*
26	to each affine piece; by `pic0Map_coe` that restricted class `picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U)
27	lam.1` is the carrier of the degree-zero class `pic0Map C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam`, to which
28	`_eq_univ` applies again.  So the residue holds with no presentation, no plus-fibre, no arithmetic,
29	and no `rep` — the numeric coverage result already contains the openness that CHART-U(b) needs.
30	
31	## Why this is the right carrier and does not overclaim
32	
33	`Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean:52-55` warns that `chartLocus` (on the *test*) and the
34	open-immersion `V` (on the *divisor scheme*) do **not** meet, and that no tree declaration relates
35	them.  This file respects that: it discharges only the *test-side* openness residue `haff`, which
36	is exactly what `chartLocusOpens`/CHART-U(b) consumes; it does **not** touch antecedent 1
37	(`IsChartUniv`/`RestrictedChartFibre`), the pointwise-to-neighbourhood spreading-out that
38	`Pic0ChartCoverageSlice.lean` records as absent, or `rep`.  No antecedent of
39	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` is closed here — one of B-4's two named inputs to CHART-U(b) is.
40	
41	## Main declarations
42	
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible` — for the admissible parameter and any
44	  degree-zero class, `ChartLocusAffineLocal` holds unconditionally.
45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpens_admissible_eq_top` — the open of the test that
46	  `chartLocusOpens` produces from that residue is all of `T.left` (the locus is `univ`).
47	-/
48	
49	set_option autoImplicit false
50	/- Statements mix `relCurve C L` with the product spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`. -/
51	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
52	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161). -/
53	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
54	
55	universe u
56	
57	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
58	
59	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
60	
61	open AlgebraicJacobian
62	
63	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
64	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
65	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
66	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
67	  [IsIntegral C.left]
68	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
69	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
70	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
71	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
72	
73	noncomputable section
74	
75	/-- **DAT-B B-4 at the admissible parameter, unconditionally.**
76	
77	At the coverage chart index `(m, Z) := admissibleCoverageParameter hπ g` supplied by
78	`exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`, the affine-local openness residue
79	`ChartLocusAffineLocal` holds for *every* degree-zero class `lam : pic0Subgroup C T` over *every*
80	test `T`, with no presentation, plus-fibre, or arithmetic hypothesis: the chart locus of the
81	restricted class is `Set.univ` and `univ` is open.
82	
83	This retires the `haff` argument of `chartLocusOpens`/CHART-U(b) at the parameter coverage
84	actually uses.  The chart index is the one `_eq_univ` produces; the same `(m, Z)` witnesses the
85	degree calibration `hdeg` (`hmZ.1`) that a chart datum also wants. -/
86	theorem chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible
87	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
88	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ)
89	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
90	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
91	    ChartLocusAffineLocal C
92	      (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose
93	      (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose
94	      T lam.1 := by
95	  -- the locus of the class restricted to each affine piece (`pic0Map`, `pic0Map_coe`) is all of
96	  -- `Set.univ` by `_eq_univ`, and `Set.univ` is open.
97	  intro U
98	  rw [← pic0Map_coe (C := C) (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam,
99	    (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
100	      (pic0Map C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)]
101	  exact isOpen_univ
102	
103	/-- The open of the test that `chartLocusOpens` produces from the residue above is all of
104	`T.left`: the underlying locus is `Set.univ`. -/
105	theorem chartLocusOpens_admissible_eq_top
106	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
107	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ)
108	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
109	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
110	    chartLocusOpens C
111	        (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose
112	        (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose
113	        T lam.1 (chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible hπ g hχ lam)
114	      = ⊤ := by
115	  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
116	  change chartLocus C _ _ lam.1 = _
117	  rw [(exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
118	    lam]
119	  rfl
120	
121	end
122	
123	end AlgebraicGeometry

I have completed the verification. Here is my verdict.

## VERDICT

### (a) Proof honest — YES

Both theorems in `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ChartAffineLocalUniv.lean` are honest:
- No `sorry`, no `admit`, no `axiom` in the file (grep clean).
- LSP diagnostics: fully elaborated, zero errors/warnings.
- `lean_verify` on both `chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible` and `chartLocusOpens_admissible_eq_top` reports axioms exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` — nothing else in the transitive closure. So the entire dependency chain (including `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`, `pic0Map_coe`, coverage) is sorry-free and gate-free.

The proof mechanism is exactly as described: `intro U`; rewrite `picEtMap C (fromSpecAffine T U) lam.1` backward through `pic0Map_coe` (a genuine `rfl`-lemma, `Pic0Functor.lean:140`) into the carrier of `pic0Map C (fromSpecAffine T U) lam`; apply `_eq_univ`'s `choose_spec.choose_spec.2` to rewrite `chartLocus = Set.univ`; close with `isOpen_univ`. It typechecks.

### (b) Vacuous/degenerate — NO

- `pic0Subgroup C T` is a `Subgroup` (`Pic0Functor.lean:107`), so it always contains `1` (`one_mem'`). The theorem quantifies over a provably nonempty carrier — not vacuous.
- The predicate genuinely matches the consumer. `ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam` (`Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean:132`) unfolds to `∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))`. The `haff` argument of `chartLocusOpens` (`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:115-118`) is the *character-for-character identical* Prop, with the same carrier `picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam`. This is confirmed operationally: `chartLocusOpens_admissible_eq_top` actually feeds `chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible` in as the `haff` argument to `chartLocusOpens` and elaborates cleanly. It is the SAME predicate the chart-u/c9b clause (i) needs, not a look-alike with a different carrier.
- The content is a short corollary (openness of `univ`), but the strength is legitimately imported from `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`, a real coverage theorem asserting `chartLocus = Set.univ` for every deg-0 class over every test. That is a strong statement, and it is axiom-clean. So this is a genuine consequence, not a trick.

### (c) Duplicate — NO (incomparable, not strictly-less)

The new theorem is NOT a duplicate of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest` (`Pic0ChartPlusFibreProducer.lean:316`, needs `IsPlusHonest`) or `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` (`Pic0ChartLocusPlusFibre.lean:120`, needs per-piece `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`). The strength comparison is a genuine tradeoff, not strict dominance:

- New theorem drops ALL of those hypotheses (no `IsPlusHonest`, no plus-fibre, no presentation).
- But it PAYS by pinning `(m,Z)` to the specific `_eq_univ.choose`/`choose_spec.choose` admissible parameter (the others take arbitrary `m,Z`), and by restricting `lam` to `pic0Subgroup` (degree-zero classes) rather than an arbitrary `picEt` class.

So the theorems are incomparable: unconditional-but-pinned-and-deg-0 vs conditional-but-arbitrary. It does NOT secretly assume an equivalent of `IsPlusHonest` — it carries no such hypothesis; the reason it is unconditional is that at the admissible parameter the locus is literally `Set.univ`, so openness is content-free there, and the real content lives upstream in the coverage result. That is a legitimately different route, not a re-proof.

### (d) Docstring overclaim — mostly honest, one minor imprecise aside

- The negative claims are honest. The file contains exactly two theorems, neither of which mentions or discharges any antecedent of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`, clause (ii) `exists_factor`, spreading-out, or `rep`. The "discharges only the test-side `haff` residue" framing is accurate, and matches the `Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling` caveat it cites (test-side locus vs divisor-side `V` are not conflated).
- One imprecise aside (lines 84–85): "the same `(m, Z)` witnesses the degree calibration `hdeg` (`hmZ.1`) that a chart datum also wants." Here `hmZ.1` is `deg k Z = m·classDeg(thetaCechClass) − admissibleCoverageParameter`, and `admissibleCoverageParameter` (via `admissibleCoverageParameter_cast`, `Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold.lean:268`) equals `(M·δ+g)·classDeg(thetaCechClass)` — i.e. the subtracted term carries a factor of `d₁ = classDeg(thetaCechClass)`. The chart-datum calibration used elsewhere (`mem_chartLocus_of_ledgerIndex`, `hZ`) subtracts `(M·δ+g)` without that `d₁` factor. So `hmZ.1` is not literally the same equation a chart datum's `hdeg` wants unless `d₁ = 1`. This is a soft, unproved aside in the docstring, not something either theorem depends on, so it does not affect (a)–(c) — but it is a mild imprecision worth flagging.

Files inspected: `Pic0ChartAffineLocalUniv.lean` (target), `Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean:132` (predicate def + `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation`), `Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold.lean:262,381` (`admissibleCoverageParameter`, `_eq_univ`), `Pic0Functor.lean:107,140` (`pic0Subgroup`, `pic0Map_coe`), `Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:115` (consumer `chartLocusOpens`), `Pic0ChartPlusFibreProducer.lean:316` and `Pic0ChartLocusPlusFibre.lean:120` (duplicate candidates).
